title_sq: Tek Ish Parku, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Orientim Perfekt
description_sq: Tek Ish Parku, ne Rrugen Ndre Mjeda, Shitet Apartament 2+1, me Vendndodhje Perfekte!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4-te te nje pallati te ri me ashensor dhe te mireadministruar. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto prej 99m² dhe siperfaqe neto prej 86 m2. Organizimi i apartamentit fillon me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me ambientin e ngrenies dhe te gatimit, dhoma matrimoniale, dhoma e femijeve, ballkoni dhe nje tualet. Orientimi nga veri lindja e ben te kete drite gjate pjeses me te madhe te dites. Zona ofron shume facilitete duke nisur nga lokacioni perfekt, afersia me Qendren dhe me institucionet dhe per kete arsye eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per te jetuar ashtu edhe per investim. Pronari disponon dhe nje post parkimi me cmim extra 32,000 euro. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: At the former park, 2+1 apartment for sale, with perfect orientation
description_en: At the former park, on Ndre Mjeda street, 2+1 apartment for sale, with a perfect location!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​99 m² and a net area of ​​86 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room with the dining and cooking area, matrimonial room, children's room, balcony and a toilet. Orientation from north east makes it light during most of the day. The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment. The owner also has a parking post with an extra price of 32,000 euros. The property has full mortgage documentation.
